description: Import image bytes from any external or agent-native image generator into Picorn storage. Pass imageBase64 with or without a data: prefix, then use the returned imageUrl in one or more native image layers. This is the bridge for iterative generator → editor → render workflows.

imageBase64.description: Image bytes as base64, with or without a data:image/... prefix.

imageUrl.description: An image URL on a Picorn-approved host.

name.description: Asset name shown in the marketing project.

preview.description: Return an inline preview. Default true.

name: picorn_editor_import_image
title: Picorn Editor: import image asset
